```python import json import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.itv import ITVIE from youtube_dl.utils import determine_ext, parse_duration, clean_html, get_element_by_class class FakeITVIE(ITVIE): def __init__(self, webpage, playlist_json): super().__init__(downloader=None) self._webpage = webpage self._playlist_json = playlist_json def _download_webpage(self, url, video_id, note=None, errnote=None, timeout=None, *, data=None, headers=None, query_string=None, errback=None, fatal=True): return self._webpage def _download_json(self, url, video_id, data=None, headers=None, note=None, timeout=None, errnote=None, errback=None, fatal=True): return self._playlist_json def test_itvie_normal_extraction(tmp_path): # Sample webpage containing the required attributes and JSON-LD webpage = '''
This is a description.
''' # Sample playlist JSON with media files and subtitles playlist_json = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": "https://cdn.example.com/", "MediaFiles": [ {"Href": "/video1.mp4"}, {"Href": "/video2.m3u8"} ], "Subtitles": [ {"Href": "https://cdn.example.com/subs_en.vtt"} ], "Duration": "PT1H30M" } } } ie = FakeITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) result = ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/liar/2a4547a0012") assert result["id"] == "2a4547a0012" assert result["title"] == "Liar - Series 2 - Episode 6" assert result["description"] == "This is a description." assert result["duration"] == 5400 # 1h30m in seconds # Formats should contain both mp4 and m3u8 entries formats = result["formats"] assert any(f.get("url") == "https://cdn.example.com/video1.mp4" for f in formats) assert any(f.get("url") == "https://cdn.example.com/video2.m3u8" for f in formats) # Subtitles should contain the vtt file subtitles = result["subtitles"] assert "en" in subtitles assert any(sub["url"] == "https://cdn.example.com/subs_en.vtt" for sub in subtitles["en"]) def test_itvie_missing_media_and_subtitles(tmp_path): # Webpage with attributes but no media files or subtitles webpage = '''
''' playlist_json = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": None, "MediaFiles": [], "Subtitles": [], "Duration": "PT0M" } } } ie = FakeITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) result = ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/no-media/vid456") assert result["id"] == "vid456" assert result["title"] == "No Media Episode" assert result["duration"] == 0 # No formats or subtitles should be present assert result["formats"] == [] assert result["subtitles"] == {} def test_itvie_invalid_json_ld_fallback(tmp_path): # Webpage with no JSON-LD but with BreadcrumbList containing TVEpisode webpage = '''
''' playlist_json = { "Playlist": { "Video": { "Base": None, "MediaFiles": [{"Href": "/fallback.mp4"}], "Subtitles": [], "Duration": "PT5M" } } } ie = FakeITVIE(webpage, playlist_json) result = ie._real_extract("https://www.itv.com/hub/fallback/vid789") assert result["id"] == "vid789" assert result["title"] == "Fallback Episode" assert result["duration"] == 300 formats = result["formats"] assert any(f.get("url") == "https://example.com/fallback.mp4" for f in formats) ```
